_comment: Hand-curated links between overnight trails in the top-100 catalogue (catalog_data/trails_canada.json) and backcountry campgrounds/permits (backcountry_sites). Backcountry sites have no coordinates, so links can't be derived automatically. Trails are keyed by (name, province_code), the same natural key the trail seed uses; sites by Parks Canada resourceId, with the provider name and code alongside so the seed can warn if they drift (like backcountry_park_overrides.json). `notes` are shown to hikers; `review` holds evidence and open questions for reviewers and is never seeded. `order` is the position along the route in the direction given in `direction`; stops sharing an order are individually booked pads at the same place (`stop`). Every overnight trail in the top 100 appears here; trails with no Parks Canada sites list only `booking`. A few day hikes are listed with `overnight_option: true`: they stay day hikes but their campgrounds are shown as 'Also doable as an overnight'.
status: Approved 2026-10-15. Links marked likely stay likely until verified; the trail page shows them with a 'route order approximate' note. Booking systems marked confirmed: false are shown as 'Booked outside Trekly'. Non-Parks Canada URLs stay null until verified.

confidence.exact: Parks Canada's own data ties the site to this route: its map area (Jasper 'Skyline'), its trail-code prefix (Banff 'Sk' = Skoki), or a description that names the route.
confidence.likely: Inferred from route knowledge and site names; Parks Canada's data doesn't say so. Check before approving.

campgrounds.name: SH1
campgrounds.notes: Stormhaven, on the Bruce Trail past the Grotto. Up to 4 people per site.

Trip reports put it about 3.4 km from Cyprus Lake. High Dump (HD1-9) is about 9.5 km further, so it's left off this day hike.

trails.name: Brazeau Loop
trails.review: Added 2026-11-03 (approved). Parks Canada: 81 km, 5 days, 'demanding'. Seasonal caribou closure north of Four Point Nov 1 - May 15. Sources: https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/ab/jasper/activ/passez-stay/arrierepays-backcountry/sugg-sentiers_trip-ideas/brazeau

trails.name: Chilkoot Trail
trails.review: Added 2026-11-03 (approved). Dyea, Alaska over Chilkoot Pass to Bennett, BC: 'a hike for experienced backcountry hikers'. Campground distances from Parks Canada's descriptions. Bennett has no road (train, boat or plane out). Sources: https://parks.canada.ca/lhn-nhs/yt/chilkoot/activ/randonnee-cdn-hiking

trails.name: Fundy Circuit
trails.review: Added 2026-11-03 (approved). Parks Canada: a 48 km network of seven linked trails, 3-5 days. Point Wolfe PW162/164 are frontcountry sites Parks Canada sets aside as an extra stop on the Circuit. Sources: https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/nb/fundy/visit/sentiers-trails/circuit

trails.name: Mount Assiniboine via Bryant Creek
trails.review: Added 2026-11-03 (approved). From the Mount Shark trailhead up Bryant Creek and over Assiniboine Pass to Lake Magog (BC Parks: 21 km to the pass). Lake Magog is booked through Assiniboine Lodge. Sources: https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/ab/banff/activ/arrierepays-backcountry, https://bcparks.ca/mount-assiniboine-park/hiking/

trails.name: Lake Minnewanka Shoreline Trail
trails.review: Added 2026-11-03 (approved). Parks Canada itinerary: 7.8, 9 or 11.1 km one way to Lm8/Lm9/Lm11. Lm20-Lm31 are further along the shore. Seasonal restriction Jul 10 - Sep 15 (groups of 4). Sources: https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/ab/banff/activ/arrierepays-backcountry

trails.name: Tamarack Trail
trails.review: Added 2026-11-03 (approved). Parks Canada: 36.4 km, the park's longest trail, 2-3 days, rated difficult. Rowe Lakes trailhead to Red Rock Canyon. Sources: https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/ab/waterton/culture/histoire-history/faits-facts, https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/ab/waterton/activ/experiences/randonee-hiking/etat-sentiers-trail-conditions

trails.name: North Molar Pass to Fish Lakes
trails.review: Added 2026-11-03 (approved). About 15 km one way from the Mosquito Creek trailhead over North Molar Pass (about 795 m of gain). Parks Canada's Mo5 description mentions North Molar Pass. Sources: https://hikebiketravel.com/fish-lakes-hike-banff/, https://www.10adventures.com/hikes/icefields-parkway/north-molar-pass/

trails.name: Fryatt Valley
trails.review: Added 2026-11-03 (approved). Parks Canada: 22 km one way, 2-3 days, very steep headwall. Sources: https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/ab/jasper/activ/passez-stay/arrierepays-backcountry/sugg-sentiers_trip-ideas/fryatt

trails.name: Sawback Trail
trails.review: Added 2026-11-03 (approved). Parks Canada itinerary: 74 km over six nights, Banff to Lake Louise; Johnston Creek or Luellen Lake for one night. Sources: https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/ab/banff/activ/arrierepays-backcountry

trails.name: North Boundary Trail
trails.review: Added 2026-11-03 (approved). Parks Canada: 159 km one way, 7-10 days, for experienced backpackers. Ends on BC Parks' Berg Lake trail. Sources: https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/ab/jasper/activ/passez-stay/arrierepays-backcountry/sugg-sentiers_trip-ideas/north-boundary

trails.name: Eva Lake
trails.review: Added 2026-11-03 (approved). Parks Canada: 14.2 km return, 465 m, from the summit shuttle stop. Mid-July to September. Sources: https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/bc/revelstoke/activ/randonee-hiking/sommet-journee-summit-day

trails.name: Taylor Lake
trails.review: Added 2026-11-03 (approved). Parks Canada: 6.3 km one way, 585 m gain. A day hike with an overnight option. Sources: https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/ab/banff/activ/randonnee-hiking/meleze-larch

trails.name: Jonas Pass - Poboktan Creek
trails.review: Added 2026-11-03 (approved). Parks Canada: 54 km one way, 3-4 days; needs a shuttle (44 km between trailheads). Sources: https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/ab/jasper/activ/passez-stay/arrierepays-backcountry/sugg-sentiers_trip-ideas/poboktan

trails.name: Outport Trail
trails.review: Added 2026-11-03 (approved). Parks Canada: 35 km return from Newman Sound campground; Minchins Cove (14 km) and South Broad Cove (16 km), also reachable by boat. Sources: https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/nl/terranova/activ/ran-hik/outport, https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/nl/terranova/activ/camping/bc

trails.name: Fishing Cove Trail
trails.review: Added 2026-11-03 (approved). Parks Canada: the park's only designated wilderness campground, a 6 km hike down to the coast. Sources: Parks Canada site description (reservation system)

trails.name: Maligne Pass
trails.review: Added 2026-11-03 (approved). Parks Canada: 48 km one way, 2-3 days, fords and route finding. Sources: https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/ab/jasper/activ/passez-stay/arrierepays-backcountry/sugg-sentiers_trip-ideas/maligne-pass

trails.name: Les Crêtes
trails.review: Added 2026-11-03 (approved). Parks Canada: 33.2 km return including access, 1437 m of gain. The lean-to takes no alerts (shelters aren't confirmed). Sources: https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/qc/forillon/activ/randonnee-hiking, https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/qc/forillon/activ/camping/arriere-backcountry

trails.name: Snug Harbour
trails.review: Added 2026-11-03 (approved). Parks Canada: 15 km return on an unmarked route along Western Brook Pond; fording Western Brook. Sources: https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/nl/grosmorne/activ/experiences/arriere-pays-backcountry/snug

trails.name: Northern Traverse
trails.review: Added 2026-11-03 (approved). Parks Canada: about 27 km (33 km in the hiker guide), 3-4 days, unmarked, harder than the Long Range Traverse. Starts with the Western Brook Pond boat. Sources: https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/nl/grosmorne/activ/experiences/arriere-pays-backcountry/northtrav

trails.name: Jade Lakes
trails.review: Added 2026-11-03 (approved). Parks Canada: 18.8 km return, 714 m, branching off the Eva Lake trail at 5.4 km. Sources: https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/bc/revelstoke/activ/randonee-hiking/sommet-journee-summit-day

trails.name: Athabasca Pass
trails.review: Added 2026-11-03 (approved). Parks Canada: 48.5 km one way, 4-5 days, dangerous fords. Sources: https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/ab/jasper/activ/passez-stay/arrierepays-backcountry/sugg-sentiers_trip-ideas/athabasca-pass

trails.name: Geraldine Lakes
trails.review: Added 2026-11-03 (approved). Parks Canada: 6.2 km one way, 1-2 days, boulder fields and a steep headwall. Sources: https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/ab/jasper/activ/passez-stay/arrierepays-backcountry/sugg-sentiers_trip-ideas/geraldine

trails.name: Jacques Lake
trails.review: Added 2026-11-03 (approved). Parks Canada: 12.2 km one way, 1-2 days, valley-bottom hiking. Sources: https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/ab/jasper/activ/passez-stay/arrierepays-backcountry/sugg-sentiers_trip-ideas/Jacques

trails.name: Goat Lake
trails.review: Added 2026-11-03 (approved). Parks Canada: from Red Rock Canyon, 4.6 km on the Snowshoe trail (hike or bike), then up to the lake. Sources: Parks Canada site description (reservation system)

trails.name: Waterton Lakeshore Trail
trails.review: Added 2026-11-03 (approved). Parks Canada: Bertha Bay is reached 'via the Bertha/Lakeshore trail'; Boundary Bay sits at the international boundary on Upper Waterton Lake. Sources: Parks Canada site descriptions (reservation system)

trails.name: Crandell Lake
trails.review: Added 2026-11-03 (approved). Parks Canada: 'perfect for first-time backcountry campers', a short hike or bike. Sources: Parks Canada site description (reservation system)

trails.name: South Boundary Trail
trails.review: Added 2026-11-03 (approved). Parks Canada: 121 km one way, 7-10 days, route finding needed. Ends outside the park at Rocky Pass. Sources: https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/ab/jasper/activ/passez-stay/arrierepays-backcountry/sugg-sentiers_trip-ideas/south-boundary

trails.name: Saturday Night Lake Loop
trails.review: Added 2026-11-03 (approved). Parks Canada: 24.6 km loop from Jasper town, 2-3 days. Sources: https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/ab/jasper/activ/passez-stay/arrierepays-backcountry/sugg-sentiers_trip-ideas/SaturdayNight

trails.name: Hermit Trail
trails.review: Added 2026-11-03 (approved). Parks Canada: 3.2 km one way, 820 m gain, one of the steepest trails in the park. Mostly a base for climbing in the Hermit Range. Sources: https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/bc/glacier/activ/randonee-hiking/journee-day

trails.name: Fiddle River
trails.review: Added 2026-11-03 (approved). Parks Canada: 37.8 km one way, 2-3 days, unbridged crossings. Ends in Whitehorse Wildland (Alberta Parks campgrounds). Sources: https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/ab/jasper/activ/passez-stay/arrierepays-backcountry/sugg-sentiers_trip-ideas/fiddle

trails.name: Chaba Trail
trails.review: Added 2026-11-03 (approved). Parks Canada: 14.8 km to Athabasca Crossing on an old fire road, suited to first-time backpackers. Sources: https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/ab/jasper/activ/passez-stay/arrierepays-backcountry/sugg-sentiers_trip-ideas/chaba
